recoverySection.subtitle: Automatic cadence after a no-show (immediate, 2 days, 7 days) and follow-up reactivation

recoverySection.structuredFlowsHint: When the patient replies "RESCHEDULE" or "Yes" (waitlist), it offers times and confirms on its own — works even with AI turned off.
